scripts.build: vite build && tsup electron/main.ts electron/preload.ts --format esm --out-dir dist-electron
scripts.package: pnpm build && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const path=require('node:path');const {spawnSync}=require('node:child_process');const src=path.join(process.cwd(),'electron-builder.yml');const tmp=path.join(process.cwd(),'electron-builder.package.local.yml');let status=1;const clean=()=>{try{fs.unlinkSync(tmp);}catch{}};try{const lines=fs.readFileSync(src,'utf8').split(/\r?\n/);const out=[];let skipping=false;for(const line of lines){if(!skipping&&/^publish:\s*$/.test(line)){skipping=true;continue;}if(skipping){if(line.length===0||/^[^\s]/.test(line)){skipping=false;} else {continue;}}if(!skipping) out.push(line);}fs.writeFileSync(tmp,out.join('\n'));const result=spawnSync(process.execPath,[require.resolve('electron-builder/out/cli/cli.js'),'--config',tmp,'--publish','never'],{stdio:'inherit'});status=result.status ?? 0;} finally {clean();}process.exit(status);"
